mapper.select: SELECT id, store_code AS code, name, address, phone, TIME_FORMAT(open_time, '%H:%i') AS open_time, TIME_FORMAT(close_time, '%H:%i') AS close_time, status FROM dc_store WHERE id = #{storeId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED') AND deleted = 0
SELECT id FROM dc_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_cart (user_id, store_id, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{storeId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM dc_cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND option_signature = #{signature} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM dc_cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND option_signature = #{signature} AND deleted = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_cart_item (cart_id, product_id, option_signature, quantity, deleted) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{signature}, #{quantity}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_cart_item SET quantity = quantity + 1 WHERE id = #{itemId} AND cart_id = #{cartId} AND deleted = 0 AND quantity < 99
UPDATE dc_cart_item SET quantity = 1, deleted = 0 WHERE id = #{itemId} AND cart_id = #{cartId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_cart_item_option (cart_item_id, selection_type, option_group_name, selected_name, catalog_value_id, price_delta, deleted) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{selectionType}, #{groupName}, #{selectedName}, #{catalogValueId}, #{priceDelta}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.image_url, p.price AS base_price, i.quantity FROM dc_cart_item i JOIN dc_cart c ON c.id = i.cart_id AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN dc_product p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE i.cart_id = #{cartId} AND i.deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.id DESC

SELECT o.id, o.selection_type, o.option_group_name AS group_name, o.selected_name, o.price_delta FROM dc_cart_item_option o JOIN dc_cart_item i ON i.id = o.cart_item_id AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN dc_cart c ON c.id = i.cart_id AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE o.cart_item_id = #{itemId} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.selection_type, o.id
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_cart_item_option o JOIN dc_cart_item i ON i.id = o.cart_item_id JOIN dc_cart c ON c.id = i.cart_id SET o.deleted = 1 WHERE o.cart_item_id = #{itemId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND o.deleted = 0
UPDATE dc_cart_item i JOIN dc_cart c ON c.id = i.cart_id SET i.deleted = 1 WHERE i.id = #{itemId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0
